summary: All four Checks pass (build, vet, test, secrets; exit 0). The Revision is scoped to the fenced-update operator script plus its regression test, and it can fast-forward origin/master. It removes the .data.kernel.running == false idle-window requirement (now accepts a running Kernel with no live Runs), forces and verifies a fresh audit via forest audit show --rescan --json before restart, drops the passive audit_timeout wait, and removes the forest.prev rollback artifact so a restored pre-change .gitignore keeps the next clean-tree check clean.
